info.title: Lume API contract proposal
info.description: Contract exercised by the local Request/Response simulation, not a deployed API. The injected transport performs no network calls. Administrative identity is simulated, not real authentication. Private state is scoped to the app/request, with browser-only draft persistence. The future server must enforce authentication, organization isolation, retention and transactional guarantees. Date ranges are inclusive UTC dates. Endpoints marked x-demo-only must not be connected to production without an operational design. Reads return no-store; all writes carry an Idempotency-Key. HTTP search maps to CaseFilters.query; 404/410 reveal no personal fields.
